# Builder

`jaff.codegen.Builder`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Orchestrate plugin-based code generation for a chemical network.

`Builder` is the top-level entry point for users who want to
generate a complete solver project (e.g. a Python `solve_ivp` wrapper or
a C++ CVODE driver) from a parsed network by selecting a named template.

## Constructor

`#!python Builder(network)`

**Parameters**

**network** : _Network_
: Parsed chemical reaction network.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `network` | `Network` | The network instance provided at construction time. |
